title: LeBron James Hits Pacers Defenders With Cold Celebration as Iconic Moment Goes Viral - NewsBreak
text:
By Shabiha Akter ,
1 hours ago
LeBron James and Pacers defenders (Photo by X/@TheHopCentral) The Los Angeles Lakers bounced back with a win over the Indiana Pacers on Wednesday. In the previous game, LeBron James drew attention after going scoreless in the first half against the Detroit Pistons , but he quickly silenced doubts with another standout showing.
During the second quarter of Wednesday’s game, the 41-year-old electrified the arena by finishing a spectacular shot over two Pacers defenders before pointing at them in celebration.
This season marks James’ historic 23rd year in the NBA and his second season playing alongside his son. Yet his performances continue to resemble those of a much younger star.
King James recently made headlines again by surpassing Robert Parish for the most games played in league history. In Wednesday’s victory, he finished with 23 points, nine rebounds, and nine assists while shooting 9-for-17 in 34 minutes.
Chris Broussard Questions LeBron James’ Fit Alongside Luka Doncic Since the arrival of Luka Doncic, James has quietly taken on a third-option role behind Doncic and Austin Reaves . On First Things First, NBA insider Chris Broussard argued that this situation may not align with James’ historical preferences. Broussard said LeBron’s high basketball IQ makes it hard to believe he would view a high-volume shooting style of Luka as the most effective approach.
Luka Doncic and LeBron James (Photo by Imagn Images) “Look, we all talk about how high his basketball IQ is, historically high. There’s no way LeBron is sitting there watching Luka shoot 30 shots and miss two-thirds of them, thinking that’s smart. I’m not saying he has any issue with Luka or anything, but he’s watching this. There’s no way he thinks that’s the best way to play basketball ,” Broussard said.
Despite the speculation, James has publicly praised the Slovenian star as a generational talent. He has even adjusted his own game to complement him and openly recognized the 27-year-old as the franchise cornerstone moving forward.
